title: Charlie’s Chalk Dust | SALTS | Apple Tobacco 60ml
description:
Charlie’s Chalk Dust | SALTS | Apple Tobacco 60ml
Apple Tobacco:
Enjoy the sweet, crisp flavor of natural apple blended with the bold taste of classic tobacco. This luxurious and smooth tobacco/fruit blend is guaranteed to satisfy and delight. Apple Tobacco by Pachamama Subohm Salts.
